name: music-platform
description: Spotify/SoundCloud-style music platform with Electron desktop and NestJS API.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,desktop -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @music/api" "npm run dev -w @music/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @music/shared && npm run build -w @music/api && npm run build -w @music/desktop
